backup_tenure_gap_on_production.classification_evidence: Opener primary (week-blocked production rule): +0.2193 accuracy points, P+=0.5737, interval [-0.8753,+1.3333] crosses zero. Neither terminal ground applies: wrong_sign_resolved requires the whole interval on the wrong side (it does not -- point estimate is positive and favours the candidate); no_split_half_reliability is inadmissible by construction -- backup_tenure_gap_flag is a deterministic function of the published schedule's listed starters plus weekly-roster season/team membership, zero measurement noise to split in half (docs/schedule_flag_battery.md Wave 9). The +44.298-point positive control (candidate column replaced by realized ats_margin, P+ 1.0 both blockings) demonstrates the harness can detect an effect of that size but does not bound THIS effect to a known small ceiling. Therefore unresolved_below_power. Per AGENTS.md's promotion-bar/decision-bar rule, P+ 0.5737 > 0.5 favours the candidate; this is not itself a promotion decision on a single confirmation look.
backup_tenure_gap_on_production.description: Opener-grade confirmation: LEAD-15 backup tenure-gap valuation. Signed flag +1 when HOME starts a system-tenured (>=2 prior seasons same franchise) backup QB OR AWAY starts a new-system backup (favours home), -1 the mirror, 0 otherwise (no backup start, or both sides independently favour the same side), on top of production weak_stack versus production unmodified, paired forced-pick probability-rule accuracy.

backup_tenure_gap_on_production.plain_summary: Backing a team that starts a quarterback who has been its backup for two or more seasons, and fading a team that starts a brand-new backup, leaned slightly toward helping picks but the result is far from conclusive on this two-season card.
